general_information.Description: The general objective of the course is to elucidate the intricate relationships between culture, heritage and contemporary tourism, analysing the economic, political and social importance of cultural tourism, exploring the phenomenon of cultural tourism from a demand and supply perspective. Introduce the basic issues of tourism culture, tourist culture in tourism development in Vietnam, tourism culture in tourism business in Vietnam, orientation for tourism culture development in Vietnam . The course focuses on the importance of culture and heritage as demand drivers for tourism, the impacts of tourism on Viet Nam and indigenous cultures, and the resulting need for managing cultural tourism. Lecturing is the main teaching method in the theory part. However, the lecturer is required to provide relevant practical and hands-on experiences by using case studies or sharing personal experiences. The learners are encouraged to actively participate in lectures by active and student-centered teaching methods such as reciprocal questioning, games, rotating chair group discussions, rountable meeting or by self-learning and preparations before the lecture, Practical training sessions are organized to allow the learners to develop their initial skills and behaviors on the tourism and travel occupational/ opereational standards. Furthermore the group assignment project will strengthen leaners' technical and soft skills such as research, team work, leadership, problem solving, work planning and scheduling, presentation and so on.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is mandatory. Attending at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Be well prepared in advance and actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by the instructor, including the group assignment project and practical training sessions - Use their own laptop and smartphone in class only for learning purposes and when requested - Read the textbooks and other reading documents in advance - Access the course page on the selected education management platforms like Google Class or Moodle for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understanding of the relationships between culture, heritage and contemporary tourism and sustainability
Analyzing the economic, political and social importance of cultural tourism and current issues in the development and management of cultural and heritage tourism products
Exploring the phenomenon of cultural tourism from a demand and supply perspective

Identifying the basic issues of tourism culture, tourist culture in tourism development in Vietnam, tourism culture in tourism business in Vietnam, orientation for tourism culture development in Vietnam
Evaluating the positive and negative impacts of tourism on indigenous cultures and communities in Viet Nam, and the resulting need for managing cultural tourism.
Demonstrating professional skills in cultural and heritage tourism management through the analysis, evaluation and synthesis of academic research with field observations.
Have a sense of discipline, professional manners and a high sense of responsibility at work; Flexibility in handling situations, ability to work independently and in groups.

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom and on Edunext; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.

assessments.Category: Group assignment (presentation, written report and video assignment)
assessments.No Question: Written report: limitation of 1000 words Presentation: 20-25 mins/group
assessments.Grading Guide: Class is divided into 4-5 groups. Each group will be required to make video that requirements are as follow: 1. The video record should show the title: "Cultural Tourism subject". 2. The video should have university's logo. 3. The video should declare the names of group's members. 4. Topics will be chosen randomly and assign for students by teachers. Topics suggested are: - Introduce overview (general) information about the chosen site (i.e. history of establishment, natural/cultural tourism resources, features of the destination's attraction, suitable tourism products). - Introduce clearly about tourism infrastructure and superstructure of the site (i.e: accommodation, food and beverage, entertainment and recreational activities, etc.). - Analyzing the economic, political and social importance of cultural tourism and current issues in the development and management of cultural and heritage tourism products. An additional written report is submitted together with the video that clearly explain what you've done in the video as requested in each group (it will work as the subtitle for the video). On the day of the presentation, each group will spend time answering questions from lecturers and other groups about the topic.
